layout.footer: You are receiving this email because of a change to your {appName} account.

passwordChanged.subject: Your {appName} password was changed
passwordChanged.body: The password of your {appName} account was changed. Every other device was signed out.
passwordChanged.notYou: If you did not make this change, contact the administrator of this {appName} instance right away.

mfaEnabled.subject: Two-factor authentication was turned on for your {appName} account
mfaEnabled.body: Two-factor authentication was turned on for your {appName} account. From now on, signing in asks for a code from your authenticator app, or for a backup code.
mfaEnabled.notYou: If you did not do this, contact the administrator of this {appName} instance right away.

mfaDisabled.subject: Two-factor authentication was turned off for your {appName} account
mfaDisabled.body: Two-factor authentication was turned off for your {appName} account. Signing in now asks for your password only, and your backup codes no longer work.
mfaDisabled.notYou: If you did not make this change, contact the administrator of this {appName} instance right away.

verifyEmail.subject: Verify your {appName} email address
verifyEmail.body: Someone registered a {appName} account with this email address. Confirm that it is yours to finish creating the account.
verifyEmail.expiry: The link works once and for 24 hours.
verifyEmail.notYou: If you did not register, you can ignore this email.
verifyEmail.footer: You are receiving this email because this address was used to register a {appName} account.

newSignIn.subject: New sign-in to your {appName} account
newSignIn.body: Your {appName} account was signed in to from a device or network it has not been used from before.
newSignIn.notYou: If this was not you, change your password and sign out your other sessions right away.
newSignIn.turnOff: You can turn these emails off in the security settings of your account.
newSignIn.footer: You are receiving this email because a new device signed in to your {appName} account.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your {appName} password
passwordReset.body: Someone asked to reset the password of your {appName} account. Choose a new password to sign in again. Every device that is signed in will be signed out.
passwordReset.expiry: The link works once and for 1 hour.
passwordReset.notYou: If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email; your password stays as it is.
passwordReset.footer: You are receiving this email because a password reset was requested for your {appName} account.

emailChange.subject: Confirm your new {appName} email address
emailChange.body: Someone asked to use this email address for a {appName} account. Confirm that it is yours to finish the change.
emailChange.expiry: The link works once and for 1 hour.
emailChange.notYou: If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email; nothing changes.
emailChange.footer: You are receiving this email because this address was given as the new email address of a {appName} account.

emailChangeNotice.subject: A new email address was requested for your {appName} account
emailChangeNotice.body: Someone asked to change the email address of your {appName} account. The change takes effect only once the new address has been confirmed, and until then you sign in as before.
emailChangeNotice.notYou: If this was not you, use the button below. It cancels the change and signs out every device, so you can sign in again and secure your account.
emailChangeNotice.expiry: The link works once and for 1 hour.
emailChangeNotice.itWasYou: If this was you, you do not need to do anything.
emailChangeNotice.footer: You are receiving this email because a change of the email address of your {appName} account was requested.

ownershipTransferred.subject: You are now an owner of {workspace} on {appName}
ownershipTransferred.body: You were made an owner of the workspace {workspace} on {appName}.
ownershipTransferred.bodyBy: {owner} made you an owner of the workspace {workspace} on {appName}.
ownershipTransferred.powers: As an owner you can manage the workspace's members and settings, make other members owners and delete the workspace.
ownershipTransferred.notExpected: If you did not expect this, ask the owner who made the change.
ownershipTransferred.footer: You are receiving this email because you were made an owner of the {appName} workspace {workspace}.

invitation.subject: You are invited to {workspace} on {appName}
invitation.body: You are invited to join the workspace {workspace} on {appName} as {role}.
invitation.bodyBy: {inviter} invited you to join the workspace {workspace} on {appName} as {role}.
invitation.expiry: The link works once and until {date}.
invitation.notExpected: If you did not expect this invitation, you can ignore this email.
invitation.footer: You are receiving this email because someone invited this address to the {appName} workspace {workspace}.

testMail.subject: {appName} test email
testMail.body: This is a test email from your {appName} instance. If you can read it, the instance can send email.
testMail.footer: You are receiving this email because an instance administrator asked {appName} to send a test email to your address.
